title: Effect of Galactose on Permeblity Factor in Patients With FSGS and CKD Stage 5
brief_summary: This study is a proof-of-concept clinical study designed to test the hypothesis that oral administration of galactose can lower the level of a circulating factor that increases glomerular permeability to albumin in patients with resistant FSGS.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Primary FSGS
* CKD Stage 5
* Resistance to steroids and another immunosuppressive medication

Exclusion Criteria:

* Secondary FSGS
